structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E061. Tip E061: 5.0235 s, 0.7534 (seeds 0-2). Same-commit rebuilds move the 3-seed mean about 0.1-0.3 pp (E036: 0.7497-0.7544; E049: 0.7535/0.7552/0.7536), and time about 0.03 s.

Mechanisms, each tied to its experiments:
1. Epoch dial: about 0.8-2 s/pp. Trimming 12 early 20 px steps (E061) saved about 0.15 s and cost about 0 pp on 3 seeds. That is cheaper than the old 1.5 s/pp estimate. The dial is noisy, so I price it at about 1 s/pp.
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, confounded with batch size, E006) are in the tip. More than 10 time-neutral boosters came out flat or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd and LS changes). I expect further tweaks to land within ±0.15 pp of zero.
3. Time tracks pixels and steps. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Removing steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049). Freezing the stem before about 75% loses (E037, E054, E055). Group 2 tolerates a freeze from 85-90%. The whitening detach at 6% (E060) saved little.
5. Activation and architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051). ReLU (E056) saved 0.25 s and cost 0.5 pp.
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (E047), so pure systems work saves at most about 1%.
7. Noise: the population mean is about 0.752-0.7535, so headroom over the 0.75 bar is about 0.2 pp. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of 0.1-0.2 pp.

Misses: I over-predicted time when variants cut work (E052, E056, E061, which came in lower than my range). I under-predicted accuracy on E053.

Unsure:
- The rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (I guess 0.08 pp).
- Whether Muon beats SGD on CIFAR-100 here (PR #3 says no).
- Whether tanh-GELU gives a real time saving.
- Whether the PCIe judge's build matches the local one.

forecasts.reason: SGD with only momentum 0.85 probably loses 0.2-0.6 pp. The Newton-Schulz saving is only about 0.1-0.2 s.
The offline profile probably projects under 1.5% for tanh-GELU, so step 2 is likely skipped and the tip stays as measured. Any step 2 result would be near the tip.
Fewer early steps are worth about the dial's rate, so I expect a small accuracy loss of about 0.1-0.2 pp for about 0.04 s saved. That supports H5.2.1.

cruxes: What is the rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean? If it is under 0.05 pp, small differences of 0.1 pp become decidable.
Is the population mean at the tip at or above 0.7515? Whether more trims are allowed depends on it.
Does the exact-GELU to tanh-GELU swap save at least 1.5% of step time?
